metadata.title: Install-GithubRelease
metadata.description:
An installer for single-binary tools released on GitHub.
This cross-platform script will download, check the file hash,
unpack and and make sure the binary is on your PATH.

It uses the github API to get the details of the release and find the
list of downloadable assets, and relies on the common naming convention
to detect the right binary for your OS (and architecture).

findings.title: Dynamic PowerShell code execution
findings.description: Dynamic evaluation can make a script harder to inspect and may enable downloaded or constructed code to run.

findings.title: Encoded or compressed content used with dynamic execution
findings.description: Encoded or compressed data is used alongside dynamic evaluation. This can appear in legitimate tooling; review the surrounding logic.
